The current source keeps on the Trial Use table row and uses #stu only for Trial Use references, while the Managing Change table-of-contents link uses #studev with a matching section anchor. The current source already avoids the duplicate #stu target and the local Managing Change link resolves to the intended section; changing #studev to the exact proposed name #stu-change would be a cosmetic anchor rename and could unnecessarily disturb existing links.
